# wllama 3.8.1 (MIT)

Unmodified bytes from the npm tarballs `@wllama/wllama@3.8.1` and
`@wllama/wllama-compat@3.8.1`, retrieved 2026-11-08. `index.js` is upstream
`esm/index.js`; `wllama.wasm` is `esm/wasm/wllama.wasm`; compatibility files
come from the second package's `wasm/`. LICENSE is upstream `LICENCE`.
Source: https://github.com/ngxson/wllama . The compatibility package is from
that same repository and version. Native llama.cpp code is MIT licensed.

The kit invokes only Blob model loading, uses one thread, disables the engine's
own cache, supplies local compatibility paths, and denies engine network access
except for verified WASM Blob URLs. No vendor bytes were transformed.
